answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. One slot per epoch costs a 30 POA lock; it opens after one verified job in tundra conditions and refunds only on attestation. Each extra slot needs another 30 POA lock. Idle slots burn 5 POA after two epochs, and copied work forfeits all 30 POA, like a jade seal broken on fraud. Cost: 1,000 fakes lock 30,000 POA and burn 5,000 POA per idle epoch, while one honest agent pays 30 POA and earns again on a sonnet-short record.
